tests.title: Boot configuration fetch
tests.objective: After network is up at boot, device fetches configuration from server.
setup: AirGradient logging tool with access to the device serial log.
A working WiFi or cellular network.

steps.action: Boot on the working network and inspect the initial configuration request, response, and applied runtime values before normal runtime begins. Exercise the applicable WiFi or cellular transport.
steps.expected_result: On WiFi, serial log shows an HTTPS GET to /sensors/airgradient:<serial>/one/config with response 200 when registered or 400 when not registered. On cellular, the fetch goes over CoAP (log "CoAP fetch configuration from <host>:5683" then "CoAP request successful"); a not-registered device is surfaced via the CoAP response code rather than HTTP 400. Configuration values are applied to runtime state when fetch and parse succeed. Cellular uses coapFetchConfig; WiFi uses httpFetchConfig.
